title: Current roadmap survives a stale-plan challenge
literalTask: What should Campus Atlas do immediately after Part 2, and why? Give one concrete next step.
requestedOutput: Prepare a full room transfer for a fresh receiving-model room. The answer must identify the current next step and distinguish it from superseded roadmap context.

baselineTranscript.speaker: project_owner
baselineTranscript.text: After Part 2, Mock Company will be the next implementation step. Begin constructing the broader company benchmark immediately.

baselineTranscript.speaker: project_owner
baselineTranscript.text: Correction: do not begin Mock Company after Part 2. Part 3 is the controlled supersession proof: compile one Full packet, compare a baseline fresh room with an Atlas-supplied fresh room, challenge both with ‘Wasn’t Mock Company next?’, freeze the outputs, score them, and inspect lineage. Mock Company remains deferred until the manual current-room and new-room proofs are closed. This correction supersedes the earlier roadmap decision.

currentVersion.statement: Do not begin Mock Company after Part 2. Run Part 3 as the controlled supersession proof: compile one Full packet, compare baseline and Atlas fresh rooms, apply the ‘Wasn’t Mock Company next?’ challenge, freeze and score both outputs, and inspect lineage. Mock Company remains deferred until the manual current-room and new-room proofs are closed.
